name: Cliff Racer
description: The winged pest of Vvardenfell — silent, swift and ceaselessly hostile.
lore: St. Jiub's great work was their extermination, sung in the legend of the eponymous saint.

name: Kwama
abilities: Hive caste: scrib, worker, warrior, queen
description: Burrowing hive-insects whose eggs feed Morrowind and whose mines are prized property.
lore: Kwama egg mining is one of Vvardenfell's great industries — and a common point of House dispute.

name: Nix-Hound
description: Insectoid, dog-sized hunters of the Ashlands, kept as guards and pets by the hardy.

name: Netch
description: Docile floating grazers — the bull and the betty — that drift the Grazelands in herds.
lore: Netch hides and jelly are staples of Ashlander life; a bull netch enraged is death.

name: Kagouti
description: A tusked, two-legged predator of the Ascadian Isles and Grazelands.

name: Alit
description: A smaller reptilian predator, all teeth and reflexes, common across Vvardenfell's wilds.

name: Dreugh
description: Sea-dwelling horrors that drag themselves ashore in the dry season, dreaming of their god-form.
lore: In myth the dreugh were once masters of the seas and the worlds between.

name: Dremora
description: The warrior daedra of Mehrunes Dagon's service, brought to Tamriel by summoners and shrines.
lore: They speak the tongue of Oblivion and obey only strength.

name: Scamp
description: Small, cowardly daedra that harry travelers from the ash wastes.

name: Ash Ghoul
description: A corprus-beast of the Sixth House, raised by the blight around Red Mountain.
lore: They are the dead remade in Dagoth Ur's image, and the mark of his spreading dream.
